east, one of the four quarters of the compass

clue.text: Cancer - perhaps it's not right to talk about it

Elizabeth Regina
the Roman numeral

clue.text: Like worms, Nicodemus couldn't believe them

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means worldly, material matters as opposed to heavenly ones, and also literally things of the soil.

clue.text: Teatime's around four - or five?

setter's reading: the hesitation shows an approximate guess at a time

clue.text: Port rebuilt with new part

clue.text: Publication with IT facility - ring for help in starting

clue.text: Jailing fascists caught in specious activity?

clue.text: Prone to deceit ...

second meaning: telling falsehoods

clue.text: Fighting man's happy to stir up a riot

clue.text: Tries afresh at a second attempt

clue.text: One needs to be in form to inform

clue.text: Vehicle to avoid?
